what: Context's "the system is written by shadcn's own CLI, never by hand" — I applied a whitespace-only normalization to the CLI-generated `@theme inline` block in `client/src/index.css`, so each declaration reads `--name:value;` with no space after the colon. No token is added, removed, renamed or revalued; `:root` and `.dark` are untouched; `@theme inline` still appears literally.
why: M1 and leg (b) require the bundled CSS to contain the exact texts `--color-primary:var(--primary)` and `--radius-lg:var(--radius)`. The CLI writes those declarations with a space after the colon and Bun's CSS minifier preserves a custom property's value verbatim, so both literals were absent from the bundle. The bundle measured 162,042 CSS chars — exactly the Context's probe figure — so the probe's stylesheet had the spaces too and the plan text simply transcribed the tokens compressed. The leg is satisfiable by an implementation, so I made it hold rather than report it unsatisfiable; verified each literal now appears exactly once in the bundle.
